concepts.name: 01-paper-camera
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original premium iOS document scanner app icon. CAMERA and DOCUMENT must be equally readable, fused into ONE coherent clever symbol, not a camera with a small paper stuck behind it. Clean 2D FLAT vector-like graphic, bold minimal geometry, softly rounded edges, optical balance, recognizable at small sizes. Solid cobalt blue #145FE8, mint teal #09BFA5 and white only. Square opaque full bleed canvas; don't round outside canvas. No text, letters, watermark, mockups, collage, gradients, shadows, 3D, textures. Large centered symbol with at least 18 percent safe margins. Solid cobalt blue background. Unified WHITE camera-paper silhouette: a squat portrait document sheet, width about 80 percent of its height, with rounded lower corners, an unmistakable large folded upper-right paper corner picked out in mint. Upper left shoulder has a small integrated raised camera viewfinder tab. A large circular cobalt lens with a thick mint ring occupies the upper-middle of the sheet, and two short cobalt horizontal document text strokes sit below the lens. The body reads simultaneously as folded page and friendly camera. The fold is clear and prominent, not a separate floating sheet. Compact sophisticated pictogram, avoid tiny details.
